title: `withdraw` does not reduce `staked` data when staker is caller
summary: _Resolved_  ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Low  ## Description  When` withdraw` is called, it updates `liquidity.total` based on the amount of shares burned, but it doesn't check if the caller is the `staker`.
